Benfi, nicknamed “The Jewel of Gruni”, is the 7th biggest and 3rd wealthiest city in Republic of Sordland. It is located in the south-eastern region of Gruni by the Ves Sea.
It is internationally renowned for its beaches and wine, and very popular as a cheaper alternative to the luxurious coasts of Lespia. It produces 1/5 of Sordland’s tourism income alone.
